name: GET civilian Log entries
info:
Fetches initial log entries when a connection is first established. Uses the same normalization pipeline as Get new entries.

### Input
`msg.payload` = Connection object

### Logic
1. Determine source (non-wasos) and target (wasos) from connection clients
2. Attach metadata with connection_name
3. Fetch via GET subflow -> sort by time -> split -> normalize -> prune

### Output
Same as Get new entries: Entry with Metadata, topic `new_message`

### Note
Currently hardcodes source as non-wasos client. Will need adjustment for non-wasos<->non-wasos connections.

name: Sort by time
func:
msg.payload.sort((a, b) => a.timeCreated - b.timeCreated);
return msg;
